title: Secret Vault
description: Store API keys and logins locally so agents can use them without the values ever reaching the model.
emptyDescription: Add an API key or login. Agents reference it by name, never by value.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Agents write {{example}}.
form.domainsHint: Comma separated. The secret is only ever sent to these hosts.
form.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.hintsPlaceholder: What this is for (visible to admins and agents)
form.valueSaved: A value is stored. Leave empty to keep it.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Recent activity for "{{name}}". Values are never recorded.

delete.title: Delete secret
delete.description: Delete "{{name}}"? Agents will no longer be able to use it.

request.formDescription: An agent needs a secret to continue.
request.approvalDescription: An agent wants to use a stored secret.
request.notSent: This value is sent straight to the vault. It is not sent to the agent or the model.
request.expired: This request expired or was already answered.
